title: Logspace membership of a lifted query language
statement: Let $f$ map finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings and suppose its output length is polynomially bounded in the input length, with both the indexed output-bit language and the indexed output-length language decidable in logarithmic space. For either choice of query mode, the language obtained by applying the two-stage index-dropping transformation and then testing the corresponding output bit or output length is decidable in logarithmic space.
